learning_outcomes.text: Know and be able to design pneumatic circuits applied to machines
Know and be able to design oleohydraulic circuits applied to machines

assessment_rules: The final grade will be composed of 35% from the 1st partial exam, 35% from the 2nd partial exam, and 30% from practices. To pass the course, each partial exam must have a grade higher than 4 out of 10. Practices are evaluated by attendance and an individual practice report, which must be submitted before the date of the 2nd partial exam. Students may opt for a final written exam covering all theoretical and practical aspects of the subject if requested at least 15 days before the exam date.
